messages:
alex: quick pulse check — I ran the new apples-to-apples run comparing our replay harness (captured traffic) vs synthetic traffic for JSON-mode + funcall workloads. Observed ~22% higher p95 latency in replay. logs attached.

june: are we sure the replay preserved the same batching distribution? replay might have more short sequences -> different kernel selection.

alex: good point. I used replay_replay_v2 with original timestamps but set interarrival scaling factor 1.0. batching config: continuous_batching_enabled=true, max_batch_tokens=4096. snippet:
```
cmd: ./replay --trace traces/2025-02-10.json --scale 1.0 --profiling
config: {"batch_window_ms":10, "max_batch_tokens":4096}
```

sam: bench summary from perf-bot:
perf-bot: p50: 18ms (synth) vs 17ms (replay)
perf-bot: p95: 46ms (synth) vs 56ms (replay)
perf-bot: token-throughput similar

casey: does KV cache hit-rate differ? replay has many repeating prefixes so should be better, which would reduce latency not increase it.

alex: KV hits: synth 12.4%, replay 33.1% — so replay actually had higher kv hits. makes the regression worse.

june: could be kernel selection: with a lot of short sequences and higher KV hits, runtime may pick small-seq SIMD kernels that are slower for fused op path. check kernelselect logs.

sam: kernelselect.log shows for model:gpt-small, replay chosen kernel=attn_simd_v2 for 20-64 tokens; synth chose attn_fused for >64 because synth had longer average length. Weird because replay had shorter lengths.

casey: also JSON mode validation adds overhead. Did we run with strict JSON validation in replay? That can cause retries on malformed outputs and extra CPU.

alex: yes replay used --json-validate=true. synth run used false (legacy). I re-ran with both false: p95 delta reduced to 6%.

june: okay so it's a combo: JSON validation + kernel selection differences due to token length distribution + batching jitter. Next steps: 1) re-run replay with json-validate=false 2) force kernel=attn_fused in kernelselect for a canary 3) add synthetic trace that matches replay token-length histogram and run again.

sam: I'll schedule runs and post raw flamegraphs. Also will add a deterministic seed for function-call order; some retries in tool-calling path due to validation failures add extra round-trips.

alex: thanks. filing follow-up ticket -> ENGRT-1427. tagging @eng-runtime on the ticket. :thumbsup: 

perf-bot: scheduled job 2025-03-12T17:04:00Z to re-run with new configs.
